newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares drop on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares drop on profit taking.

text.p: 1707 GMT - Portuguese shares dropped on profit taking in average turnover of 7.6 billion escudos, weakened by the fall of other markets and the dollar. The Lisbon market ignored the rise of Wall Street. Dealers noted firm demand for rights of Sonae Investimentos and a fall in ship repairer Lisnave to a 1997 low of 290 escudos. They said they expected the market to recover tomorrow with the entry of foreign investors. "Today's correction is very healthy," said one operator. "The market has room to fall a little further, but then it will correct upwards again."
